personalInfo.name: Mahnoor Ghalib
personalInfo.title: Senior Software QA Engineer | Automation | Mobile & API Testing | Performance & Quality Excellence
personalInfo.summary: Senior QA Engineer with over 5 years of experience in web, mobile, and API testing across fintech, ride-hailing, and healthcare domains. Skilled in building automation frameworks, designing detailed test strategies, and ensuring quality across full SDLC. Experienced in working with Agile teams, performing production-level validations, and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-performing, stable, and secure software products. Strong background in research, AI, and data-driven testing with exposure to ML-based problem-solving.
